title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30380: add OnSplitPostedWhseReceiptLineOnNotFindWhseItemEntryRelation event
summary: A new integration event OnSplitPostedWhseReceiptLineOnNotFindWhseItemEntryRelation is added to codeunit 6500 Item Tracking Management, allowing extensions to customize the handling of posted warehouse receipt lines when no warehouse item entry relations exist.
key_points: New integration event added in SplitPostedWhseRcptLine method's else branch
Event uses IsHandled pattern to let extensions override default behavior
Enables custom splitting logic for posted warehouse receipt lines
Follows existing event pattern already used in the codeunit
Addresses extensibility gap when WhseItemEntryRelation records not found
